description: Source code for the NodeRestriction admission plugin in Kubernetes, implementing node-based access control and validation logic.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: Represents the NodeRestriction admission plugin, handling node-based access restrictions and validation.

methods.name: InspectFeatureGates
methods.description: Sets feature gate-dependent flags based on enabled features.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeInformerFactory
methods.description: Registers informer factories for pods, nodes, and CSI resources.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates that the plugin has been properly initialized with required dependencies.

methods.name: SetAuthorizer
methods.description: Sets the authorizer used for access control decisions.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Main admission entry point, dispatching requests based on resource type and operation.

methods.name: admitPod
methods.description: Handles admission logic for pod creation, deletion, and status updates.

methods.name: admitPodCreate
methods.description: Validates pod creation requests from nodes, ensuring owner references and annotations are correct.

methods.name: admitPodStatus
methods.description: Validates updates to pod status, ensuring only allowed fields are modified.

methods.name: admitPodEviction
methods.description: Validates pod eviction requests, ensuring they are from the correct node.

methods.name: admitPVCStatus
methods.description: Validates updates to PersistentVolumeClaims, restricting modifications to specific fields.

methods.name: admitNode
methods.description: Validates node creation and update requests, restricting label modifications and config source changes.

methods.name: getModifiedLabels
methods.description: Computes the set of label keys that differ between two label maps.

methods.name: isKubernetesLabel
methods.description: Checks if a label key belongs to Kubernetes system namespaces.

methods.name: getLabelNamespace
methods.description: Extracts the namespace part from a label key.

methods.name: getForbiddenLabels
methods.description: Determines which labels are forbidden for nodes to set or modify.

methods.name: admitServiceAccount
methods.description: Validates token requests from nodes, ensuring they are bound to the correct pod and service account.

methods.name: validateNodeServiceAccountAudience
methods.description: Validates that token request audiences are present in the pod spec and authorized.

methods.name: podReferencesAudience
methods.description: Checks if a pod references a specific audience in its volumes or CSI tokens.

methods.name: getCSIFromPVC
methods.description: Retrieves the CSI driver name associated with a PVC.

methods.name: csiDriverHasAudience
methods.description: Checks if a CSI driver supports a specific token request audience.

methods.name: admitPodCertificateRequest
methods.description: Validates PodCertificateRequest objects, ensuring they are from the correct node and pod.

methods.name: admitLease
methods.description: Validates lease objects, ensuring they are in the correct namespace and match the node name.

methods.name: admitCSINode
methods.description: Validates CSINode objects, ensuring they are from the correct node.

methods.name: admitResourceSlice
methods.description: Validates ResourceSlice objects, ensuring they are created or deleted by the correct node.

methods.name: admitCSR
methods.description: Validates CSR objects, ensuring they are for the correct node and signer.
